whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Is Your Ad Budget Going to Waste Because of Ordinary Designs?
whatIs.paragraph1: Are you spending thousands on ad budgets but not getting the clicks and sales you expect? The problem is usually not the targeting, but ordinary designs that fail to grab attention.
whatIs.paragraph2: In the digital world, users decide whether to scroll past your ad within the first 1-3 seconds. What saves you in this critical moment of decision is visual quality, message clarity, and the trust your brand conveys.
whatIs.paragraph3: As Sybor Digital, we analyze the algorithms and user psychology of Meta, TikTok, Google, and LinkedIn to produce 'scroll-stopping' and conversion-oriented ad designs that persuade people to click.

whatWeDo.label: How We Help You
whatWeDo.title: Conversion-Oriented Creatives for Every Platform
whatWeDo.paragraph1: Every social media platform has its own visual language and consumption dynamics. We design Instagram Feed, TikTok Video, or LinkedIn Banner creatives not as identical copies of each other, but from scratch according to the spirit and dimensions of the platform.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: We don't settle for a single design; we produce multiple variants so you can run A/B tests. We help you find the most profitable ad with different combinations of headlines, striking visuals, and Call-to-Actions (CTAs).
whatWeDo.paragraph3: Not just for one-off campaigns; with our monthly design subscriptions, we ensure your digital marketing processes have a continuous and fast visual production line.

whyUs.label: Why Sybor Digital?
whyUs.title: A Design Team That Knows Marketing
whyUs.subtitle: An approach that doesn't just look appealing, but increases sales with psychological triggers.

reason1.title: We Understand Performance
reason1.description: We produce sales machines, not works of art. We calculate the impact of every color, font, and visual placement in the design on the click-through rate (CTR).

reason2.title: Mastery of Platform Algorithms
reason2.description: We know the technical and algorithmic requirements of all platforms inside out, from Meta's 20% text rule to TikTok's safe zone margins.

reason3.title: Agile Delivery at Agency Speed
reason3.description: Ad campaigns can't wait. To ensure you don't miss out on the agenda or trends, we deliver most design sets within 2-3 business days without compromising quality.

reason4.title: Flawless Brand Consistency
reason4.description: Even in different campaigns, we never compromise on your brand's corporate guidelines, color palette, and tone. Every visual is your brand's signature.

reason5.title: Flexible and Solution-Oriented Revisions
reason5.description: You may need to analyze data and make quick changes while the campaign is live. We process your revision requests swiftly without getting bogged down in bureaucracy.

reason6.title: Sustainable Monthly Packages

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: The answers to the questions on your mind are here.

delivery.question: How long does it take for designs to be delivered?
delivery.answer: Standard static ad sets are usually delivered in 2-3 business days, while motion graphics and video ads take 3-5 business days depending on their scope.

pricing.question: How does pricing work?
pricing.answer: We have project-based one-time pricing or much more advantageous monthly subscription (retainer) packages for situations requiring continuous production based on your needs.

revisions.question: How many revision rights do I have?
revisions.answer: You have a standard of 2 rounds of revisions for each creative. Our priority is that you are completely satisfied with the design. We provide flexible revisions for our monthly package clients.

maintenance.question: Can you work with my existing brand guidelines?
maintenance.answer: Yes, absolutely. We take your brand book, strictly adhere to your fonts and color palettes, and produce designs that protect your corporate identity.

migration.question: Do you also do video ads?
migration.answer: Yes. In addition to static visuals, we produce motion graphics, 2D animations, and short Reels/TikTok video ads tailored to platform trends. (Note: Physical video shooting and production are excluded).

mobile.question: Can you upload them to my ad account?
mobile.answer: Upon request and authorization, we can upload the designs directly to your Meta Business Manager or Google Ads accounts to support your campaign setup.
